style.promptPrefix: TO BE LOCKED: choose one prefix and seed before generating any frame, then never change them — style consistency across the set depends on it. Suggested register: cold votive light, drowned architecture, teal and bone-white with gold leaf where the divine intrudes. Faces of the gods never depicted, only their geometry.
style.note: Frames are generated offline and hand-curated (ROADMAP Phase 2). Drop finished PNGs into apps/web/public/art/<slot>.png — BeatArt falls back png → svg → gradient, so partial sets are playable.

slots.brief: A small windowless stone shrine on a bare plain, ringed by standing markers. Notably, absolutely nothing glows — the only frame in the set with no divine light.
An eastward road across salt flats. A fishing weir stranded miles from any water, tilted, still strung with rotted net.
An impossibly clear inland sea seen from a bluff. Beneath the surface, an intact city grid — streets, towers, closed doors — with no silt.
A well-appointed merchant camp on a shoreline: diving apparatus laid out in rows, ledgers under a canvas awning, everything expensive.
Armoured knights in a cordon across the head of a submerged stair, standing knee-deep in still water, dawn-sigil tabards.
A paladin standing motionless in shallow water, helm off, looking at nothing. Others in the frame are still moving; he is not.
A processional stair descending into deep water, the sea held back in a clean vertical wall on either side by nothing visible.
A vast hall of tuned stone and gold-inlaid channels, built for sound. Sealed doors with no handles, keyed to a voice.
An antechamber mid-ritual: zealots in ash-grey, a half-finished resurrection circle, the geometry visibly going wrong at one edge.
A drowned sanctum containing a single suspended fragment — not heart-shaped; a fragment of an organ of judgement, geometric, attentive.
Three groups entering one chamber from three directions at once — armoured, mercantile, ash-grey — all stopping at the same instant.
Close on the fragment, filling the frame, a single small figure silhouetted against it. The light is cold, not warm.
A lone tiefling walking north on a ridge road, three faint layers of afterimage trailing a half-step behind him.
The inland sea from the bluff again, now opaque and ordinary. Silt clouding. No city visible. Water behaving normally at last.
A handover: the fragment passing between two pairs of hands, only the hands in frame, the giver's already withdrawing.
